import hmac
import hashlib
import time

def validate_reset_token(user_id, token, secret_key, expiry_seconds=3600):
    current_time = int(time.time())
    parts = token.split(':')
    if len(parts) != 3:
        return False
    token_user_id = parts[0]
    timestamp = int(parts[1])
    provided_signature = parts[2]
    if token_user_id != str(user_id):
        return False
    if current_time - timestamp > expiry_seconds:
        return False
    expected_signature = hmac.new(
        secret_key.encode(),
        f"{user_id}:{timestamp}".encode(),
        hashlib.sha256
    ).hexdigest()
    if hmac.compare_digest(expected_signature, provided_signature):
        return True
    return False
